sentences.en: Charles Walcot investigated the magnetic compass bearing sense in pigeons.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·沃尔科特研究了鸽子的磁罗盘方位感应。

sentences.en: In the evening my pigeon returned to me wounded seriously.
sentences.zh: 傍晚时分，我的鸽子带着重伤回到了我这里。

sentences.en: Oh, dear pigeon, how I wish I had your wings!
sentences.zh: 哦，亲爱的鸽子，我多么希望我也能有你的翅膀！

senses.zh: 鸽子,<非正式>易受骗的人,<非正式>责任
